name: find
summary: search for files in a directory hierarchy
description: Walk the directory tree rooted at PATH (default: .) and print each matching entry. Use -n for shell-glob name filtering, -t to restrict by type (f/d/l), and --maxdepth to limit recursion depth.

options.description: filter by type: f=regular file, d=directory, l=symlink
descend at most N directory levels (0 = starting path only)
